Benoist / reprogramming / limiting beliefs / anxious thoughts / family patterns.  Related skills: the-mountain-is-you (self-sabotage patterns), nonviolent-communication (observing without judgment), the-power-of-now (presence and awareness), clear-thinking-book (overcoming cognitive biases).
